LanguageData.JptMoody.Text000: Left click to toggle between ascending and descending sort. Right click to remove.
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text009:
Colonist Temperature Comfort
Extremely Hot Hot Comfortable Cold Freezing
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text013: Conditions requiring attention such as fresh untended wounds, illness, heatstroke/frostbite, and the like.
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text014: Conditions that do not require immediate attention. In terms of game logic, the inverse of 'Attention Required'.
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text015:
Current Job
A red icon indicates the colonist is drafted or downed.
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text018: Disabled when pawn picture is disabled
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text025: Groups pawns by map or caravan. If unchecked, sorting will mix all pawns among maps and caravans
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text029: If enabled, displays the mood box behind the picture similar to the colonist bar
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text030: If enabled, shows each pawn's ideology icon before their label
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text031: If enabled, shows each pawn's label in the pawn column. If disabled, enables Show Pawn Picture.
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text032: If enabled, shows each pawn's picture in the pawn column. If disabled, enables Show Pawn Label.
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text033: If enabled, shows each pawn's profession as part of their label. If disabled, only the name is shown (if Show Pawn Label is enabled).
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text034:
Immunity (Lethal)
If immunity reaches 100% before severity reaches 100% the pawn becomes immune and severity begins to degrade until the condition is gone.
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text038: Left click to sort by label. Default sort order can be restored from the right-click context menu.
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text039: Left click to toggle between ascending and descending sort. Right click to remove.
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text040:
Left click to toggle between ascending and descending sort. Right click to switch between overall mood and individual needs
When viewing overall mood the colonists are sorted by how close they are to their respective breaking thresholds, not overall mood value.
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text044: Number of colonists with a thought from this group
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text045: Number of colonists with this thought
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text050: Remember size and position between sessions
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text052:
Severity (Lethal)
If severity reaches 100% before immunity reaches 100% the pawn will die.
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text060: Smaller text, icons, and row height to fit more on the screen. Shows ~50% more rows for the same height.
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text061: Status of conditions requiring attention. They are either lethal or can be tended by another colonist.
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text065:
Tend Status
Untended conditions heal more slowly and some can degrade into worse conditions.
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text072: Toggle between colonist, prisoner, and animal modes
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text073: Total mood bonus across all colonists
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text074: Total mood penalty across all colonists
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text075: When bleeding out, a warning will be displayed in place of the mood/need in the Summary view. Clicking the warning will remove it until the next bleeding out event.
LanguageData.JptMoody.Text076: When sleeping (not just resting) the sleep need will override the selected need in the summary view
